_comment: Send a real prompt and capture two follow-up states: thinking (just after send, AI working) and response (AI response card visible). Costs ~2 WPForms-AI API calls on sulliesbakery.com. Form is NOT modified — Accept is never clicked.

variants._comment: Open modal, fill textarea, click send, capture immediately after spinner appears.

steps.eval: (()=>{const ta=document.querySelector('#wpforms-smart-edit-modal textarea');ta.value='Make all fields required and add a GDPR consent checkbox';ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));})()
